{{quote|The ''Hall," the Tower envoy scoffed. "Do not believe me blind to where the power lies. That so-called ''Hall thinks what you six tell them to think.|{{6|12}}}}
The '''Salidar Six''' is an informal name given by fans to the six [[Aes Sedai]] who orchestrated the core of the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] in the abandoned village of [[Salidar]]. Sometimes, this group is referred to as "Sheriam and her circle" or "Sheriam's council," which predates Egwene's [[Egwene al'Vere's Council|council of advisors]]. Each sister had significant influence in her Ajah in her own right, and together were extremely effective in the shaping of events during the [[White Tower Schism]]. These women are:

#'''[[Sheriam Bayanar]]''' - ostensibly of the [[Blue Ajah]] and former [[Mistress of Novices]] under [[Siuan Sanche]]. Undoubtedly the leader of the group, she was even offered the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in exile, and the strongest in the [[One Power]] among them. Installed herself as [[Keeper]] under [[Egwene al'Vere]], presumably with the intention of being able to steer Egwene according to the will of the Salidar Six, although her motives were later revealed to serve a darker purpose.
#'''[[Anaiya]]''' - also of the Blue Ajah. It has been speculated that she was [[First Selector]] of the Blue Ajah, and though there is no hard evidence for this, she is certainly someone to whom many Blues listen.
#'''[[Myrelle Berengari]]''' - of the [[Green Ajah]]. She is fairly young for an Aes Sedai - only raised to the shawl fifteen years ago - but has risen very far in influence. She is strong in the One Power and became [[Captain-General (Green Ajah)|Captain-General]] in the rebel camp.
#'''[[Beonin Marinye]]''' - of the [[Gray Ajah]]. Although one of the sisters that helped organize the rebels in the first place, she was an undercover agent for [[Elaida]].
#'''[[Morvrin]]''' - of the [[Brown Ajah]]. Morvrin may be on the [[Brown Ajah Council]] or even [[First Chair]], as suggested by her appearance before the Hall to put Egwene forward as Amyrlin.
#'''[[Carlinya]]''' - of the [[White Ajah]]. Held as much sway as most Sitters even before the Tower's division.

In true Aes Sedai custom, these women are all very strong in the [[One Power]], at least before the discovery of the main characters. With a strength level of {{opsl|20}}, Sheriam was one of the strongest sisters in the rebel faction with only [[Lelaine Akashi]] and [[Romanda Cassin]] being stronger. Anaiya, Carlinya, Morvrin and Myrelle are all at strength {{opsl|21}}, whereas Beonin is at {{opsl|22}}. It is likely that they assumed their superior strength would give them dominance over the rebellion. Although Lelaine could have presented a challenge to their authority, Romanda was not expected to have joined the cause. We also see that the only two sisters who can match Sheriam in the rebel faction, [[Bera Harkin]] and [[Kiruna Nachiman]], were deftly maneuvered to search for the Dragon Reborn in the Aiel Waste. This does not seem accidental, but rather way to get rid of two potential rivals known to work together. Only a single known rebel sister, [[Maigan]], is as strong as the Anaiya et al.

==Activities==

After the [[Tower Coup]], these six sisters organized the gathering at Salidar and established themselves as the leaders of the rebellion. At this point, they enjoyed considerable authority.

Siuan convinced the six that they must give the rebellion credibility by electing their own [[Hall of the Tower during the White Tower Schism|Hall of the Tower]] and their own [[Amyrlin]]. The Rebel Hall was elected first: new [[Sitters]] to replace those that remained loyal to the Elaida and the White Tower. None of the circle of six became Sitters, presumably to avoid personal liability. The existence of this newly elected Rebel Hall did not hamper the clout of these women in the slightest. 

{{quote|The common run of folk never noticed, of course, but Elayne had caught snippets among the Aes Sedai about Sheriam and her little council. Some thought they only saw to the day-to-day running of Salidar, freeing the Hall for more important matters. Some knew they had influence with the Hall, but how much varied according to whom they spoke.|{{6|15}}}}

After much discussion, the Salidar Six selected Egwene to be their representative for Amyrlin because:

*She was strong in the power.
*She was not in the White Tower at the time of the coup.
*She was someone they thought they could control.
*They did not wish to become sidelined if [[Lelaine]] or [[Romanda]] became Amyrlin.

In other words, the six could pull the strings of Egwene, the perfect puppet Amyrlin, and increase their power in the matters of the Rebel Hall. Sheriam, Myrelle, and Morvrin were the three Aes Sedai who appeared before the Rebel Hall to put Egwene forward as Amyrlin.

At this time, the Salidar Six also recruited [[Gareth Bryne]] to build them an army. It is also these six who tried to learn the secrets of ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' and who sent the [[Rebel Spies]] to Tar Valon.

In the beginning, the six women dictated all that Egwene should do and agree to in the Rebel Hall, as planned. With the help of Siuan, however, Egwene gradually became free of their influence. Slowly the influence of the Salidar Six among the other sisters began to lessen. Their power was further reduced when Egwene learned of the six women's use of rebel spies placed in the White Tower, unbeknownst to the Rebel Hall. Egwene leveraged an oath of fealty from the six women, sworn in secret, for as long as Egwene was to be Amyrlin.

At Egwene's insistence, each of the six (minus Sheriam as Keeper) were nominated as representatives for each of their respective Ajahs on [[Egwene's Council]]. The only person on the council not in the Salidar Six was [[Nisao Dachen]], representing the [[Yellow Ajah]]. Their official position was advisers to the Amyrlin. After Egwene's capture, they were left powerless without the Amyrlin present to advise. They were unable to even enter the Rebel Hall once in sitting. 

Only three of the original six - Myrelle, Morvrin, and Carlinya - remained among the Rebel until the White Tower was reunited. 
# Anaiya was murdered by [[Aran'gar]] the night the Rebel Hall voted to ally with the [[Black Tower]]. 
# Beonin was always Elaida's undercover agent. She defected to the White Tower and betrayed the names of the Salidar spies in the White Tower to Elaida. She also taught Elaida all the newly rediscovered weaves (such as [[Traveling]]).
# Sheriam was [[Black Ajah]]. She held great influence as one of the Salidar Six (often seen as the leader of the six) and later as Keeper. It's unclear if being Black Ajah landed her into those powerful roles. She confessed to several disturbing crimes. She stole several [[Sleepweaver]] ''ter'angreal.'' Otherwise, it's unclear what orders she carried out for [[Mesaana]] and other [[Forsaken]]. Sheriam was stilled and executed along with 50 other Black Sisters in the camp before the rebels returned to the White Tower.
